prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Houston, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1207; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to what happened, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine. For the record, can you describe where the accident took place?
A: It was on a multi-lane highway in Houston, Texas, heading into the city during the morning commute. I was in the middle lane.
Q: What were you doing right before the collision?
A: I was changing lanes to the right because my exit was coming up. I checked my mirror, saw nothing close, and started to move over.
Q: Did you signal before you moved?
A: I did. I had the turn signal on for a few seconds before I started drifting over.
Q: What happened next?
A: A vehicle in the right lane came up beside me fast and clipped the side of my car. It pushed me toward the shoulder and I had to correct hard to keep from going off the road.
Q: Did you have any contact with the other driver afterward?
A: We both pulled onto the shoulder. The other driver got out and said they didn't see me, and that was about it.
Q: Did you feel any injury at the scene?
A: My right knee hit the center console when the car jolted. It was sore right away, and by the time I got home it was swollen.
Q: Have you sought medical treatment for the knee?
A: Yes, I saw a doctor the same week. They ordered imaging and told me to keep weight off it for a while.
Q: Is there anything you would like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I was careful and signaled properly. I just want my knee taken care of and my car repaired.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
